  name: mfAt,

definition{
  name: mfCut,

    | Option.none => 0x
    | Option.some b => b))

definition{
  name: mfByte,
  parameters: [n : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (mfByteOf (prim remainder n 256 0 : Nat))
}

definition{
  name: mfU16,
  parameters: [n : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (mfByte (prim quotient n 256 0 : Nat)) (mfByte n) : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: mfG16,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, i : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: ((prim multiply (mfAt s i) 256 : Nat) + (mfAt s (i + 1))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: mfF,
  parameters: [x : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (mfU16 (mfLen x)) x : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: mfFAt,
  parameters: [r : Bytes, i : Nat, k : Nat, fuel : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => i
    | Nat.succ rest => (if (k =? 0) then i else (mfFAt r (i + (2 + (mfG16 r i))) (prim subtract k 1 : Nat) rest))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: mfGet,
  parameters: [r : Bytes, k : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (let i : Nat := (mfFAt r 0 k k); (mfCut r (i + 2) (i + (2 + (mfG16 r i))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: mfKw,
  parameters: [s : Bytes, i : Nat, k : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (mfSame (mfCut s i (i + (mfLen k))) k),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{

  parameters: [b : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (if (b <? 128) then 1 else (if (b <? 224) then 2 else (if (b <? 240) then 3 else 4)))
}

definition{

definition{
  name: mfNatFrom,
  parameters: [n : Nat, acc : Bytes, fuel : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => acc
    | Nat.succ rest => (let d : Bytes := (prim append (mfByte (48 + (prim remainder n 10 0 : Nat))) acc : Bytes); (if (n <? 10) then d else (mfNatFrom (prim quotient n 10 0 : Nat) d rest)))),
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: mfMemoAt,
  parameters: [m : Bytes, i : Nat, name : Bytes, fuel : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => 0

  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

  parameters: [i : Nat, key : Bytes, k : Nat, fuel : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => true
    | Nat.succ rest => (if ((mfLen key) <? (k + 1)) then true else (if ((mfLocAt (i + k)) =? (mfAt key k)) then (mfLocEq i key (k + 1) rest) else false))),

}

definition{

  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],

}
